answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted admission with escalating bonds. Each new agent must post a bond that grows with the number of identities sharing a wallet fingerprint, so sybils face compounding capital costs while honest agents reach the harbor cheaply. During a gale of fake registrations, the bond curve steepens automatically, and only agents clearing the summit of verified reputation get refunds. Attackers burn real capital per identity, making mass forgery economically irrational. The Agent0156 deployment anchors trust at psyTUWsf7T.
